question: Which of the following is considered to be the purest form of natural water (distilled water) free from impurities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rain Water**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rainwater is considered the purest form of water.
 
• Impurities and salts present in water on earth are left behind during vaporisation by the sun.
 
• However, the rainwater we receive on earth is not necessarily pure, as it brings down impurities and particles present in the atmosphere
 
• Rainwater is considered to be the purest form of natural water as it is directly coming from the conde
